action_items: Backend suite had no tests to run; Phase 1 has no API-bearing acceptance criteria and frontend services are intentionally mocked.

checks.name: application-shell-navigation
checks.evidence: Desktop shell rendered VayuDrishti sidebar, operational header, and navigated through all requested routes with expected page titles.

checks.name: dashboard-mission-view
checks.evidence: Dashboard rendered 4 metric cards, VD-001 map marker, cyclone status, satellite preview, DEMO prediction summary, wind/pressure charts, and recent events.

checks.name: cyclone-monitor-selection
checks.evidence: Registry displayed VD-001, VD-002, and VD-003; selecting VD-002 updated selected detail and map marker context.

checks.name: satellite-layer-switching
checks.evidence: INSAT-3D frame metadata rendered and switching from IR to WV activated the selected layer; UI labeled MOCK FRAME / NO NETWORK FETCH.

checks.name: prediction-workspace
checks.evidence: Prediction page rendered DEMO / MOCK DATA, forecast values 118 and 124, 91% confidence, impact window, track placeholder, and both charts.

checks.name: history-methodology-views
checks.evidence: History seasonal chart/archive rendered; About methodology pipeline rendered and clicking stage 03 updated detail to Classify with future-service boundary text.

checks.name: settings-preferences-persist
checks.evidence: Wind, pressure, alert, refresh, and scanline controls changed; save feedback appeared; dashboard reflected 64 kt after navigation.

checks.name: responsive-shell-drawer
checks.evidence: At 390px viewport document width stayed within viewport and mobile navigation opened as a drawer with scrim and closed successfully.
